verdictMapping.reason: Focused VoiceOver repro repeats the original marker glyph and group-suffix behavior while current engine output omits marker glyphs and emits positional suffixes for focusable generic descendants.

supportedScope: CSS/custom marker content on native list items can be VoiceOver-visible before item text and still include item position.

A native list item whose spoken content is a focusable generic descendant, produced by span[tabindex="0"][aria-expanded="false"] under ignored span wrappers, can be announced as '<text>, group' instead of '<text>, N of M'.
The engine should have focused unit coverage for native li rows with ignored decorative icon siblings and focusable generic text descendants.
unsupportedScope: Do not generalize to all card boundaries, all plan CTAs, all image/logo cards, Dash app integration grids, carousel/group behavior, or Dropbox selectors/classes.
Do not use this repro as a Phase E promotion target or a live-site corpus fixture.
Do not treat the pending explicit-file-url rerun as completed evidence until its artifact exists.

loopBack.handoffReason: Implement narrow reusable behavior for marker glyph output and focusable generic descendants in native list items; keep site fixture cleanup separate.

nextRecommendedWorker.scope: Only list marker glyphs and focusable generic descendant group suffixes inside native list items
nextRecommendedWorker.reason: C.5 raw VoiceOver reproduced the two disputed contracts; confidence is medium because fixture-path scan lacks mini AX/snapshots but original AX supplies the DOM/AX contract.

suggestedFocusedUnitCoverage: Native ul/li with CSS marker content '\u2022\u2002' should include marker glyph before list item text.
Native ul/li with ignored icon span plus span[tabindex=0][aria-expanded=false] text descendant should emit group suffix rather than parent list position on the descendant stop.
Adjacent plain li siblings should continue to emit positional suffixes.
